name: 019_learning_goal_completion
description: User completes a series of learning goals — completion state must be in memory.

episodes.text:
User: I'm starting to learn Kubernetes. I know Docker well but Kubernetes is new to me.
Assistant: Good progression.

User: I finished the Kubernetes fundamentals course. I can now deploy pods and services.
Assistant: Great milestone!

User: I passed the Certified Kubernetes Administrator exam today!
Assistant: Congratulations, that's a serious certification.

User: Next goal: I want to learn Helm and GitOps with ArgoCD.
Assistant: Natural next steps in the k8s ecosystem.

planted_facts: User completed a Kubernetes fundamentals course
User passed the Certified Kubernetes Administrator exam
User wants to learn Helm and ArgoCD
